title: feat(pathkernel): the crate skeleton, the stage types and the planner switch
body:
Side branch: side/path-kernel

## What this PR adds

- The new crate `camcraft-pathkernel` in `crates/pathkernel/`. It depends only on `camcraft-geometry`. `camcraft-motion` depends on it and re-exports it as `camcraft_motion::pathkernel`. The app gets it through that re-export (`camcraft_app::pathkernel`). There is no direct app edge.
- The stage types of the record, with no planner logic. **One rule for the crate: valid by construction.** A value of a public type is always valid. A field that could hold an invalid value is private and is set only by a checked constructor. An enum variant with data holds a validated newtype. A list holds only validated records, and its constructor checks the rules between them (decision 12).
  - `verdict`: `Stage`, `Refusal` (a blank reason becomes `NO_REASON`), `Fallback`, `Gap`, `Gaps` (one or more), `Note`, `Verdict<T>`.
  - `frame`: `Spot`, `Positive`, `WorkPlane::Planar(PlanarFrame)`, `AxisControl::Normal`, `ToolShape::Disc(Disc)`, `PlanePoint`.
  - `region`: `MaterialSide`, `Bounds`, `KernelRegion::Planar(PlanarRegion)`.
  - `guide`: `RingRef`, `Circle`, `GuideChoice` (`Rings(RingsChoice)`, `Rows(RowsChoice)`, `Medial`, `Trace(TraceOffset)`), `Family`, `Curve` (with `same_cut`), `GuideSet` (a total order), trait `GuidePlanner`.
  - `order`: `StartSide`, `Direction`, `OrderChoice`, `OrderedSet` (law 3: only a permutation, a restart and a reversal), trait `OrderPlanner`.
  - `load`: `PLAN_TOL`, `Engagement`, `Trochoid`, `ConstantLoad`, `LoadControl`, `Reach`, `Reading`, `OverLimit`, `Controlled` (law 6), traits `StockRead` and `LoadPlanner`.
  - `link`: `LinkPolicy`, `Hop` (`Stay(StayPath)`, `Lift(LiftReason)`), `LinkTally`, trait `LinkProof`.
  - `entry`: `EntryKind`, `Area`, `Hole`, `EntryChoice`, `Proof` (each proof names its place), `Entry` (approach and descent; law 5), `Exit`, trait `EntryPlanner`.
  - `plan`: `Cut`, `Step` (`#[non_exhaustive]`), `Plan` (the step law as a transition table).
  - `recipe`: `Recipe`. `engine`: `PLANNER_ENV`, `PlannerEngine` (default `Old`), `engine_from_switch`.
- The one switch: `crates/app/src/operation/planner_switch.rs`.
  - `planner_engine()` reads `CAMCRAFT_PLANNER` one time for each process. No other code reads the setting.
  - `check_engine(kind, engine)` runs in `run_job` (`crates/app/src/operation/generate/run_job.rs`), before every arm of `run_job_arms`. The arms do not change.
  - The default is the old planner. With `new`, each of the 16 phase-1 kinds is refused by name ("the new path planner does not plan <kind> yet"). There is no fallback and no panic. A bad value gives the old planner and one diagnostic.
- The xtask entries:
  - The crate is in `ALL_CRATES`, `BATCH_CRATES` and `CLIPPY` (`xtask/src/plan.rs`). It is not in `SHARED` and not in `HEAVY_CRATES` (record). The heavy reach to motion and app comes from the manifests.
  - The hand-pinned tests are updated: `heavy_plan_tests.rs` (reach), `select_tests.rs`, `tests.rs`, `step_tests.rs`.
  - A new test checks the gate lists against the workspace members.
  - AGENTS.md "Check only the touched crates" names `camcraft-pathkernel`.
- The #3750 baseline goldens and their pins are cherry-picked from `9c69f004a` (`origin/issue/3750-shared-ring-set`). The pick applies cleanly.

## Dependency decision

The record `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md`, section "Dependency decision", is the decision for the two new edges. The choices of this step are in `docs/decisions/4055-pathkernel-skeleton.md` (items 1 to 17; items 12 to 17 are the rules of the review rework).

## Goldens moved

These 17 files are additions. They are copied unchanged from commit `9c69f004a` (`origin/issue/3750-shared-ring-set`), recorded on `origin/main` `138a592a1`. This PR changes no recorded program.

- `crates/app/tests/golden/offset2d_fig8_auto.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/offset2d_fig8_inside.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/offset2d_fig8_inside_arc.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/offset2d_fig8_outside.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/offset2d_fig8_outside_arc.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/level_rings_band.txt`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_auto.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_auto_blind.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_inside.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_inside_arc.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_inside_rings.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_outside.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_outside_arc.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/offset2d_dogbone_outside_rings.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/pocket_band_auto.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/pocket_band_inside.cl`
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/pocket_band_outside.cl`

## Pins

- `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws.rs`, a new directory suite with one submodule for each stage. The tests use the public API only. New top-level test file: the new crate has no suite yet, and the record puts the K7 law suite (#4027) in this directory. The tests:
  - `construction`: each constructor refuses NaN, infinity, zero, an empty list and a blank reason by name (finding 3).
  - `order`: restarts and reversals pass; the crossing square, a swapped vertex order, a shifted open curve, a changed circle, a changed index, a changed family and a moved point are refused (finding 1).
  - `plan`: each cell of the transition table, with two disconnected cuts in a row (finding 2).
  - `entry`: a descent outside the proved place is refused for each proof kind, and a hole proof for another hole is refused (finding 4).
  - `load`: the limit domain, malformed records, double, stray and mismatched records (finding 5).
  - `guide`: all 24 input orders of four curves with equal keys give one set; equal lowest points give one start (finding 6).
- The unit tests of `engine` (3).
- `switch_default_is_the_old_planner` (app, `offset_pass_start`, heavy lane): the 2D Offset Inside on `fig8.step`, through the dispatch with the switch at its default, against the #3750 golden `offset2d_fig8_inside.cl`.
- `switch_default_passes_each_phase1_kind_to_the_old_planner` and `switch_new_refuses_a_kind_it_does_not_plan_yet` (app, `offset_pass_start`, default suite).
- The #3750 baseline pins (cherry-picked): `offset2d_rings_unchanged_by_the_shared_planner`, `pocket_rings_unchanged_by_the_shared_planner` and `level_rings_unchanged_by_the_shared_planner` (motion, `pass_start_levels`), and `fig8_offset_rings_unchanged_by_the_shared_planner` (app, heavy).
- cl: `cl_text_round_trips_every_golden` (it now accepts the annotation tail of a golden).
- xtask: `the_gate_lists_name_every_workspace_crate`, `a_pathkernel_change_plans_its_suites_and_the_mapped_app_suite`, `reach_follows_the_crate_dependencies`.

## Gate results

All results are on the final head `9ea79086c`. The base `origin/side/path-kernel` is `d1feeb12d`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/side/path-kernel` under `xvfb-run -a`: the gate makes it a batch, because `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` change. 1222 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (60.1 min). This includes:
  - `pathkernel suites: lib` and `pathkernel suites: laws`;
  - `app suites: offset_pass_start`;
  - `motion suites: pass_start_levels` (the #3750 baseline pins for 2D Offset, 2D Pocket and the level rings);
  - `cl suites: headless_bin`;
  - clippy `-D warnings` on the `CLIPPY` list (pathkernel, motion and app included).
- `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work` (app): ok, in the gate run above.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed (9.0 min).
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 385 passed, 0 failed.
- In release with `--ignored`, by name: `switch_default_is_the_old_planner` ok, and `fig8_offset_rings_unchanged_by_the_shared_planner` ok (107.6 s). The #3750 goldens still match on this base.

## A fix outside the brief

The first gate run had one red step: `cl suites: headless_bin` (`cl_text_round_trips_every_golden`). That test reads every app `.cl` golden as CL text. The cherry-picked goldens of `9c69f004a` end with `; note:` and `; warning:` lines. That fault came with `9c69f004a`; no output changed. The test now round-trips only the CL text and checks that the tail has only those annotation lines. The golden bytes did not change (decision 11).

## Not exercised

- The quick gate selects the suites of another crate only by their Gate map; it does not follow dependencies. A change in a kernel file plans the kernel's own suites. A change in `engine.rs` also plans `app: offset_pass_start`. No motion suite names a kernel module yet, because no motion code calls the kernel (decision 10).
- The 2D Pocket has no app-level golden in the #3750 baseline. The motion goldens `pocket_band_*` pin its rings. The switch passes the Pocket kind to the unchanged arm.
- No planner logic, so there is no K7 law suite yet (#4027).
- The full heavy lanes did not run ("Heavy lanes at review").
